source.citation: S. Navas et al. (Particle Data Group), Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024)
source.note: OUR FIT branching fractions for e/mu/tau and hadrons; width from OUR FIT

protocol.P1_null_first: 3000 Dirichlet(k) draws, matched sigma pattern and total mass, common-N scan N in [2,5000]; threshold chi2_0.95(k)
protocol.P2_injection: table-specific truth (frozen in this file), Gaussian noise at the table sigma, 100 repetitions, recovery = rational identity of proportions
protocol.P3_decision: signature present iff min-chi2 < chi2_0.95(k) AND empirical p < 0.05 vs the P1 null
protocol.P4_regime: k = 4 granularity amendment: only four W channels are measured, so the k = 5/7 calibrated granularity does not exist for this table; the null calibration runs at k = 4 with the table's own sigma, so the false-positive rate is controlled.  sigma_rel = 1.4-1.8% on the leptonic channels and 0.4% on hadrons, above the Z-pole regime; the four-channel fit has three independent constraints, and the power is correspondingly limited (P2 quantifies it).
